titre: A bishop and a pawn up. Can White win? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
King, light-squared bishop and h-pawn against a lone king in the corner: a draw. The queening square h8 is dark, so the bishop can never control it, and the black king just shuffles between g8 and h8 until stalemate (classical theory, 'wrong rook pawn'). Could you win it? 👇
